fields.Name: IT14 - Predictive Studio Stack Seams
fields.Description: Live, full-stack (headless) coverage of Predictive Studio's STACK SEAMS over the real provider — deterministic + sidecar-free (only an internal PS5 live-train leg is gated behind PS_INTEGRATION=1). PS1: ML entity CRUD round-trips through SQLServerDataProvider with typed fields intact (Pipeline/Model/Scoring Binding). PS2: the pipeline ↔ model ↔ binding FK lineage reads back correctly. PS3: the 'ML Model' Record Set Processing work type resolves the MLModelInferenceProcessor through the substrate's pluggable RecordProcessorRegistry (the exact seam RecordProcessExecutor.buildProcessor falls through to). PS4: the four PS Actions (Train / Score / Run Experiment / Promote) exist in metadata with their params + result codes and the @RegisterClass drivers resolve. PS5: invoking Train ML Model with a missing PipelineID fails cleanly (VALIDATION_ERROR, no throw). Creates + deletes all its own ML fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: ML entities round-trip with typed fields; the 'ML Model' work-type seam resolves the scoring processor; the four PS Actions are registered; a missing-PipelineID train fails cleanly.
